text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo, Trainer! How was your day 
off?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I had so much fun! I had a long video call 
with my family for the first time in a 
while, and—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"My little sisters told me so many of 
their thoughts on my race while playing 
the video for me!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Saying that stepping in like this was 
cool, or that not looking back here was 
amazing... Ehehe, it was super 
embarrassing, honestly!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to show you way more of my 
cool side! Alright, let's do this~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed to have been a wonderful break 
for Ines Fuujin!
